questions: Is a route the same in both directions? For example, if Circle to Madina costs 10 cedis, should a passenger asking for Madina to Circle also get 10 cedis?
Should only station staff be able to add routes and change fares, with passengers only able to look up fares?

If there is no direct route between two stops, should the system just say no route was found, or should it try to combine routes (for example, Circle to Madina and then Madina to Adenta) and add up the fares?
answers: Yes. Circle to Madina costs the same as Madina to Circle, so we keep one route for both directions and passengers can ask either way.
Say it was not found. Do not try to join two routes together; only direct routes count.
